scenario_facts.real_scenario: delivery-owner DO-S8 needs a final consistency-auditor advisory gate before submission, and the user challenged whether the auditor actually covers development-before and commit-before consistency.
scenario_facts.observed_pain: The prior consistency-audit skill stopped at L1-L6 canonical consistency and did not prove QA handoff obligations were executed and evidenced after development.
scenario_facts.expected_outcome: Define baseline mode and full mode, add deterministic runtime evidence closure, and prove the capability through schema, scripts, packet checks, and regression tests.

responsibilities: audit frozen baseline artifacts before development
audit final runtime evidence before submission
report drift, missing refs, blocked layers, skipped layers, and owner actions
verify QA handoff obligations close through qa-result.obligation_results
non_goals: replacing qa, verifier, code-reviewer, or delivery-owner

strategy_confirmation.confirmed_by: 用户明确说“明白了，可以开干了，干彻底”。
confirmed_scope: wire delivery-owner, qa, readiness, schemas, fixtures, and tests
validate the skill content against skill-refiner quality standards
excluded_scope: no final release signoff authority for consistency-auditor
